notes.title: Minor update patches
notes.content:
· rmbMenu configuration appends _allGrpShow attributes to control whether to display them in the #all group
The · showRmbPanel command appends the parameter specifying the display panel, showRmbPanel grpId
· main character class can be accessed through the "_campSkillCmd": "mod | any cmd, any cmd".
· Fixed a bug where Myra Skill 1 was learned by the protagonist, and the target was also effective on your own side
· Added glbValRandInt command, glbValRandInt valRes = valA~valB
· The production of urban items is added to the independent random float
· Fixed a bug where the ejection power sharing caused the summoning unit to act incorrectly

- About cloud archiving
· If the old game exists in the game library at the same time, uninstall it or close the cloud save to avoid data errors

- About the sudden failure of the game to start

1. In the case of dual graphics cards or dual monitors, you can try to turn off one monitor first, and then turn on the other monitor after starting normally
2. It may be that the antivirus software has deleted the core files of the game, please try to verify the integrity and confirm whether the antivirus software has a record
3. When it still doesn't work, you can try to leave a message in the Steam discussion forum

- The frame rate of the game is abnormal
· Because the graphics card settings override the game settings, turn on V-sync in the graphics card

notes.title: It’s online!
notes.content:
-Adjusted blitz mechanism, when triggering a blitz, the damage of the current hit will not be attenuated.
-Added a new random event protection mechanism to avoid continuous trouble.
-Slightly increase the invasion range when the Demon King's army descends.
-Slightly increased the blood level of the Demon King Boss.
-Limit the number of times the warrior protagonist's top skill cards can be used to 4.
-Enhanced some of the mage protagonist's skill cards.
-Added 5 new Summoning Skill Cards
-Added the original Summon's action mechanism, if the Summon can still act at the end of the turn, it will act on its own.
-Added continuous displacement mode for special monsters.
-Added a new basic skill pool for Npc melee professions.
-Added objDodgeOk, objFlash message events.
-Added hitPowerPull skill tag, which turns flying enemies into pulling them towards you.
-Added a new hitSlot tag that sets the speed of melee penetration.
-Enhanced the effect of the talent “Lightning Mastery”.
-Fixed the bug that the talent [King of Bones] could not be leveled up.
-Fixed a bug in the triggering of certain relics.
-Fixed the bug that the Demon King Army generation may overlap.
-Adjusted the preset difficulty settings.
-Stopped movement when commenting on town names.
-Other minor adjustments

-About cloud archive
-If there is an old game body in the library at the same time, please uninstall it or close the cloud archive to avoid data errors.

--About the game suddenly can not start

1. Most of the time when there are dual graphics cards or dual monitors, you can try to turn off one monitor first, and then turn on the other monitor after normal startup.
2. may be because the antivirus software deleted the game core files, please try to verify the integrity, and confirm that the antivirus program has a record of it
3. If it still doesn't work, you can try to leave a message in the steam discussion forum.
